Continuous Improvement & Service Excellence

• Leverage data and analytics to identify trends and recommend actionable improvements.

• Support organizational transformation initiatives and service modernization efforts.

• Work together with the director, Government Relations NA, and the extended team to advance public policy topics for Lenovo in key states and communities across the US

• Develop and advance relationships with key external state and local stakeholders

• Independently identify, monitor, and analyze key issues and legislation at the state level and develop state policy strategies and outreach plans where appropriate

• Maintain regular communication with business units to support internal stakeholder awareness and review of relevant state actions

• Together with the legal department, advise business units on policy and regulatory matters that may impact the development or deployment of products and services

• Regularly and actively engage with the state government affairs committees of Lenovo’s existing trade and industry associations, bringing that knowledge back to internal stakeholders to shape overall positioning and recommend action, where appropriate

• Actively participate in state and local opportunities to represent Lenovo and its interests, including with industry trade organizations/committees, elected officials, NGOs, and others

• Closely align with Lenovo site leaders to create and execute local engagement plans, including representation and participation in the local community

• Identify appropriate lobbying support and/or consultants for key topics at the state level, aligned with Lenovo’s federal and global business priorities

• Support tax team and business units to secure and celebrate state and local incentives, including funding available for investment and workforce development

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to develop stakeholder dialogue opportunities focused on advancing Lenovo business objectives and reputation

• Bachelor’s degree in public relations, communications, political science, public affairs, law, business, economics, marketing, journalism, business/commerce, history, geography, or similar field

• 8+ years of experience in developing and managing strategic relationships to advocate and influence public/technology policy priorities at the state level

• 5+ years of experience working in the technology policy space

• A vast understanding of the North America technology market, ideally in the areas of laptop/IT hardware/mobile phones/cloud computing

• Keen understanding of the North American political system, environment, and institutions as well as cultural landscape, particularly at the state level in the US

• Solid network with the policy makers, the academia, and a working knowledge of the technology industry

• Experience with other government/policy schemes in the US States

• Interest in emerging technologies and policy work

• Outstanding judgment, persuasive and advocacy skills, creativity, and the ability to work in a dynamic environment

• Strong collaboration skills, drive for results, strategic thinking, and emotional intelligence

• Experience in Government or the diplomatic sector

• Deep experience collaborating with engineering groups and/or government officials

• Expertise in developing written materials and/or delivering content about policy issues

• Ability to incorporate different perspectives and collaborate

• Deep sense of commitment and drive to address complex challenges, individually and as part of a team

• Aptitude for learning, understanding, discussing, and representing industry and corporate policy positions for technologies and practices that are constantly changing

• Understanding of Geopolitics at the state level a plus

About Our Team

We are seeking a strategic, execution-driven Sr Business Development Manager – AI Partnerships to accelerate our AI platform growth through high-impact partnerships. In this role, you will be responsible for setting partnership objectives, aligning cross-functional priorities, driving key initiatives to execution, and managing dependencies across Platform/OS partners and Content Suppliers.

This role demands a unique combination of strategic thinking, program management, and stakeholder engagement to build a thriving ecosystem around our AI initiatives.

Location: Open to remote work. Chicago, IL or Morrisville, NC preferred.

What You'll Do

1. Partnership Framework Execution

• Drive execution of partnership frameworks that define goals, success metrics, operating models, and joint initiatives.

• Operationalize business models around product integration and mutual technology sharing to deliver commercial outcomes.

• Ensure partnership frameworks are embedded into day-to-day collaboration with internal teams and partners.

2. Strategic Alignment & Planning

• Lead planning sessions to ensure alignment on quarterly partnership priorities and objectives.

• Own quarterly strategy reviews, performance reporting, and updates to leadership.

• Track industry and partner developments to adjust plans and maintain competitive advantage.

3. Program Management & Delivery

• Drive critical partnership initiatives from planning to completion, ensuring accountability across teams.

• Manage interdependencies and handoffs between business, product, and technical stakeholders.

• Track progress against milestones, ensuring timely delivery and partner satisfaction.

4. Risk & Issue Management

• Monitor execution and proactively identify risks, misalignments, or delivery challenges.

• Escalate issues to leadership and coordinate resolutions to maintain momentum.

5. Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Leadership

• Act as the primary driver of partner relationships, ensuring alignment with shared goals.

• Build trust and credibility with Platform/OS partners, Content Suppliers, and Silicon Partners.

• Facilitate joint reviews, executive engagement, and day-to-day coordination to ensure long-term success.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree required; MBA or technical background preferred.

• 10+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, program management, or related fields.

• Strong experience working with OS/Platform partners, technology companies, or content ecosystems.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in building or scaling partner ecosystems.

• Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• Ability to drive cross-functional alignment and influence without direct authority.

• Ability to travel 2-3 times per quarter

• Strategic thinker with an execution-first mindset.

• Outstanding communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Familiarity with AI technologies and AI ecosystems preferred.

• Understanding of AI market trends, developer ecosystems, and content integration.

• Strong analytical and operational rigor to track KPIs and partnership health.

• Agile, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.
